mapper.sql: case_id AS caseId, case_no AS caseNo, case_type AS caseType, role_type AS roleType, role_id AS roleId, qualification_type AS qualificationType, dd_program_version_id AS ddProgramVersionId, jurisdiction_code AS jurisdictionCode, tier, case_origin AS caseOrigin, source_namespace AS sourceNamespace, source_application_id AS sourceApplicationId, source_submission_id AS sourceSubmissionId, round_no AS roundNo, previous_case_id AS previousCaseId, responsible_partner_id AS responsiblePartnerId, risk_rating AS riskRating, risk_rating_note AS riskRatingNote, risk_rated_by AS riskRatedBy, risk_rated_time AS riskRatedTime, recommendation, recommendation_note AS recommendationNote, recommended_by AS recommendedBy, recommended_time AS recommendedTime, public_note AS publicNote, resolution_note AS resolutionNote, return_section AS returnSection, review_due_time AS reviewDueTime, status, active_slot AS activeSlot, operated_by AS operatedBy, on_behalf_of_partner_id AS onBehalfOfPartnerId, submitted_time AS submittedTime, decision_time AS decisionTime, version, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_due_diligence_case(case_id, case_no, case_type, role_type, role_id, qualification_type, dd_program_version_id, jurisdiction_code, tier, case_origin, source_namespace, source_application_id, source_submission_id, round_no, previous_case_id, responsible_partner_id, status, active_slot, submitted_time, version, create_time, update_time) VALUES(#{row.caseId}, #{row.caseNo}, #{row.caseType}, #{row.roleType}, #{row.roleId}, #{row.qualificationType}, #{row.ddProgramVersionId}, #{row.jurisdictionCode}, #{row.tier}, #{row.caseOrigin}, #{row.sourceNamespace}, #{row.sourceApplicationId}, #{row.sourceSubmissionId}, #{row.roundNo}, #{row.previousCaseId}, #{row.responsiblePartnerId}, #{row.status}, #{row.activeSlot}, #{row.submittedTime}, #{row.version}, #{row.createTime}, #{row.updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_due_diligence_case WHERE case_id IN #{id} ORDER BY case_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_due_diligence_case WHERE previous_case_id = #{caseId}

SELECT FROM t_due_diligence_case c WHERE c.status = 'RETURNED' AND c.review_due_time <= #{now} AND c.source_namespace = 'CCT_CLIENT_APPLICATION' AND c.role_type = 'CLIENT' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_due_diligence_case s WHERE s.previous_case_id = c.case_id) ORDER BY c.review_due_time, c.case_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM t_due_diligence_case ORDER BY submitted_time DESC, case_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_due_diligence_case SET status = #{status}, active_slot = NULL, public_note = #{publicNote}, resolution_note = #{resolutionNote}, return_section = #{returnSection}, review_due_time = #{reviewDueTime}, operated_by = #{operatedBy}, on_behalf_of_partner_id = #{onBehalfOfPartnerId}, decision_time = #{now}, version = version + 1, update_time = #{now} WHERE case_id = #{row.caseId} AND version = #{row.version} AND active_slot = 1
UPDATE t_due_diligence_case SET version = version + 1, update_time = #{now} WHERE case_id = #{row.caseId} AND version = #{row.version} AND active_slot = 1

UPDATE t_due_diligence_case SET status = 'IN_REVIEW', version = version + 1, update_time = #{now} WHERE case_id = #{row.caseId} AND version = #{row.version} AND status = 'SUBMITTED' AND active_slot = 1

UPDATE t_due_diligence_case SET risk_rating = #{riskRating}, risk_rating_note = #{note}, risk_rated_by = #{actorId}, risk_rated_time = #{now}, recommendation = NULL, recommendation_note = NULL, recommended_by = NULL, recommended_time = NULL, version = version + 1, update_time = #{now} WHERE case_id = #{row.caseId} AND version = #{row.version} AND active_slot = 1

UPDATE t_due_diligence_case SET recommendation = #{recommendation}, recommendation_note = #{note}, recommended_by = #{actorId}, recommended_time = #{now}, version = version + 1, update_time = #{now} WHERE case_id = #{row.caseId} AND version = #{row.version} AND active_slot = 1
